description: Casefolded stems that mark a skills / technologies / competencies section. Document-type-specific: these identify a skills block in a résumé (CV). Matched as a substring of a markdown header's text, so declensions and multi-word headers ("Ключевые навыки", "Стек технологий") are covered. A skills block lists tools, not employers, so ORG/LOC NER recall is suppressed inside such a section (see ADR-0007). To extend: add another stem (casefolded, no whitespace) that names a skills/technologies section heading.
